T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Greetings To You ,

It is good to get your contact from Ministry of trade database.We are expanding our global presence by investing into projects outside the Gulf region in the form of equity finance, loan/JV partnership.

We invite all interested project owners,Startup and investors to our project financing/investment program me.

Al-Omar Investment Financial wish to re-invest through project financing and investment opportunities globally. We are ready to invest in project developments and business ventures that can generate at least 3% ROI per annul for projects 5-10years term and above Renewable. Our offer for investment is based on a clear conventional fund throughout the duration of the collaboration.

We are currently providing funds. We would like you to provide us with a comprehensive business plan for our team of investment expert review.

Kindly revert back if you have projects that needs funding for further discussion and negotiation.

Looking forward to hear from you.

REGARDS,
Al-Omar Investment Financial
